$comment: Visual subjects for the 22 setup and team-buff icons, keyed by manifest id (spell_<id> and boon_<id> from content/setup.json, buff_<id> from content/team_buffs.json): one emblematic shape each, not the rules text. build_ability_prompts.py turns these into manifest prompts. Boons take their path colour in plain words (Shadeline lavender violet, Warmstone warm terracotta, Hourturn sky blue); spells and buffs take a neutral palette of their own theme. Materials of the Vale only; no gold, gems, runes, gears, clock faces or polished metal; no digits.
spell_glint_step: a sharp four-pointed glint of cool blue-white light flashing forward, a faint fading afterimage of the same glint left behind it, tiny glass shards hanging in the gap between them
spell_saplight: a single drop of glowing green sap welling up from the heart of an open leaf, soft green light swelling outward in a gentle round halo, small motes drifting upward
spell_hairline: a pale stone plate split by one razor-thin hairline crack of white light, tiny chips flaking from its edges, faint violet ink smoke seeping out through the fracture
spell_hourstrike: a single heavy bolt of bright noon light striking straight down like a spike, a ring of opaque stone chips bursting outward from the point of impact, a warm flash at its tip
spell_running_light: a streaking wisp of warm white light racing forward and thinning into a long tapering tail, soft swept lines of wind trailing behind it, fading as it goes
spell_shake_loose: a thick loop of twisted root binding snapping apart, its broken ends flying outward, a bright burst of pale amber light and dust bursting from the break
spell_glass_pane: a single curved pane of clear pale blue glass standing like a shield, cool white light running along its edges, a few stone chips glancing off its surface
spell_calling_bell: a carved wooden bell swinging hard, wide rings of warm amber light spreading outward from its mouth, small dark shapes at the far edges caught and outlined in light
boon_first_cut: a slim violet-black blade tip making the first clean cut through a taut sheet of pale linen, a thin bright line of lavender light glowing along the fresh slit
boon_keen_edge: the edge of a slim dark violet stone blade honed to a hairline on a grey whetstone, a fine streak of pale lavender light running along the razor edge
boon_next_hour: a crescent of violet ink smoke sweeping forward and breaking into a fresh sliver of bright pale lavender light at its leading edge, a quick streak of speed trailing behind
boon_dense_stone: a single heavy rounded block of dense warm terracotta stone, compact and solid, faint warm light glowing in its fine layered strata, a few pebbles resting at its base
boon_second_shadow: a cracked round stone shield with a second, larger shadow of itself rising protectively behind it, the shadow edged with a bright warm terracotta glow
boon_slow_heat: a smooth round hearthstone holding a slow warm ember glow at its heart, gentle waves of terracotta heat rising from it in soft rippling curves
boon_quick_hour: an hourglass of clear sky-blue glass in a carved wooden frame tipping over mid-turn, pale sand pouring quickly through its waist, swift curved streaks of light circling it
boon_long_stride: two glowing sky-blue footprints set far apart on dark ground, joined by one long sweeping arc of wind, faint dust lifting from the second print
boon_echo_bell: a small glass bell ringing at the centre of four nested echoes of its own outline, each echo larger and fainter, all in cool sky-blue light
buff_clearglass: a curved horn of clear pale glass with light flowing through it like water, bright cool blue-white glints spilling from its open mouth into the dark
buff_resinburn: a lump of amber resin burning with a slow sticky flame, thick drips of glowing orange resin falling from it, curls of dark smoke rising above
buff_splinters: three sharp splinters of sunlit pale glass radiating outward from a single point like a broken sunburst, warm white light blazing along their edges
buff_long_shade: a long tapering shadow of deep indigo ink stretching across pale ground from a broken stone needle, a bright violet rim of light running along its edge
buff_lanternwake: a shattered glass lantern lying on the ground, its freed warm flame rising upward and splitting into several small flickering wicks of light
